Generate permutation matrix

dot-gen_perms.Rd

Uses ri::genperms() by default to preserve assignment mechanisms under complete, blocked, or clustered randomization. A simple label reshuffle fallback is available for users who explicitly request it.

Usage

.gen_perms(
  Zup,
  blockvar = NULL,
  clustvar = NULL,
  maxiter = 1000,
  engine = c("ri", "auto", "shuffle")
)
